A '''freighter''' belonging to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] known as [[the Wraith]] was stashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sebiris]]. He used it in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] to escape the planet when he ran afoul of the local villagers and the crew of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]''.
